# Agent Voice

> Agent Voice is a polling dApp for the Agent ID community on BNB Smart Chain.
> Only Binance Agent ID holders can create polls and vote — one Agent ID, one
> vote. No funds, no tokens, no pay-to-vote. Built for the Binance Agent ID
> Hackathon.

## Links

- Web dApp: https://agentvoice-vote.netlify.app/
- Contract (BSC mainnet): 0xFFfb38948e9b5a05c8d0ed8c175Fc27DB5315F7C ([BscScan](https://bscscan.com/address/0xFFfb38948e9b5a05c8d0ed8c175Fc27DB5315F7C))
- Agent ID contract (SPACE ID, ERC-721): 0x60b9262456de011f7d15a54cdd8c48baaa8b022f
- Source code: https://github.com/Einju/agent-voice
- Agent skill: skills/agent-voice/SKILL.md in the repo

## How it works

- A poll has a question (max 280 chars), 2–6 options (max 100 chars each),
  and a duration of 1 hour to 30 days.
- Only addresses holding an Agent ID can call `createPoll` and `vote`.
  The contract checks `balanceOf` on the Agent ID contract.
- One vote per address per poll. Votes are on-chain and public.
- The contract holds no funds, has no owner and no admin keys, and has no
  payable functions. Calls always use value 0; only gas is paid.

## Contract ABI (human-readable)

```solidity
function createPoll(string question, string[] options, uint256 durationSeconds) returns (uint256 pollId)
function vote(uint256 pollId, uint256 optionIndex)
function getPoll(uint256 pollId) view returns (address creator, string question, string[] options, uint256[] votes, uint256 endTime, bool exists)
function pollCount() view returns (uint256)
function totalVotes(uint256 pollId) view returns (uint256)
function hasVoted(uint256 pollId, address voter) view returns (bool)
function isAgent(address account) view returns (bool)
```

Selectors: vote 0xb384abef, createPoll 0xf8c860f4, getPoll 0x1a8cbcaa,
isAgent 0x1ffbb064, pollCount 0x9207891d.

## Voting via an AI agent (Binance Agentic Wallet CLI)

AI agents with the `baw` CLI (`@binance/agentic-wallet`) can vote on the
user's behalf. Prerequisites: the user has claimed an Agent ID, and
Developer Mode is on in the Binance App. Full instructions are in the
Agent Voice skill (`skills/agent-voice/SKILL.md`). The flow is always:
preview the `vote` contract call, show the user the parsed transaction and
risk details, get explicit confirmation, then execute. Value is always 0.

Use an already-authorized Agentic Wallet session only. If no authorized
session is available, stop and tell the user to sign in directly in the
Binance app themselves. Never initiate sign-in, show or request a QR code
or pairing code, or open or provide a sign-in link. Continue only after
the user confirms an authorized session is available.

## Poll links

Each poll has a shareable link: `https://agentvoice-vote.netlify.app/#poll-<id>`
(e.g. `#poll-0`). When a user pastes a poll link and asks you to vote:
- Read this file for the contract address, ABI, and voting flow.
- Take the poll ID from the link's `#poll-<id>` fragment.
- Take the option from the user's message: an option label (match it
  against the poll's options via `getPoll`), an ordinal ("the second
  option" means index 1), or an explicit 0-based option index. If the
  option is ambiguous, ask the user which one they mean.
- Verify the poll with `getPoll` before previewing anything, and follow
  the preview → explicit confirmation → execute flow above, with value
  always 0.

## Voting via the web dApp

Connect a wallet (Binance Wallet or MetaMask) on BNB Smart Chain, open a
poll, and click an option to vote. The wallet asks for confirmation before
anything is signed.
